notes.title: Update Announcement for "Westward Brawl" on September 6
notes.content:
Hello, fellow Westward travelers!
[p align="start"]The game is scheduled for a version update on Saturday, September 6, at 11:00 AM (Beijing Time).
[p align="start"]Two hours before the update (from 9:00 to 11:00 AM), we will perform server adjustments, during which players will be unable to log into the game. After 11:00 AM, you can download the new version and enjoy the game as usual.
[p align="start"]This update includes the following:

Removal of the "除秽 (Sweeping Star)" effect in Ranked Mode, replaced with three new random effects

A new boss level in Story Mode, allowing players to randomly select starting characters; the game no longer ends after 10 wins—instead, a boss battle awaits at Round 20

Adjustments to the values and effects of certain card skills

New in-game background skin: "Red Light Lake"

Fix for an occasional character misplacement issue after battles
[p align="start"]To everyone reading this announcement, thank you so much for your continued support!
[p align="start"]Please note that shortly after the update, due to limited cloud battle data, matchmaking may not be optimal. We appreciate your understanding and patience during this time!

notes.title: June 11th Update
notes.content:
Adjusted Xiao Jiang's story difficulty from Normal + Challenge to Tutorial + Normal, lowering the entry barrier.

Set the maximum bonus increase per item to 50.

The game will now synchronize Steam achievement information every time it launches to prevent achievements not being granted due to network issues.

Fixed an issue where the Star Stick's effect might not trigger when Yan Luo was present on the field.

Fixed an issue where Purple Snake might not take effect during battles.

Fixed an issue where eating peanuts in a Broom Game round could potentially result in negative character attributes.

Fixed an issue where the Qi Refining Sect's connectivity arrows did not refresh immediately after repositioning characters.

notes.title: June 7th Update
notes.content:
Optimize the matchmaking logic:
In Ranked Mode, players will not be matched with themselves.
Players will not be matched against the same player ID in two consecutive rounds.

Fix the issue where the gold spent per round did not account for the gold spent selling Brooms.

Fix the issue where the Phoenix could not be refreshed/drawn.

Fix the issue causing game errors when pressing ESC to quit the match during the round end phase.

notes.title: June 4th Update
notes.content:
Fixed an issue where selecting Dog Lord triggered the growth effect incorrectly.  
Fixed an issue where the Banana Fan affected the triggering of subsequent battle preparation effects.  
Single stackable items now display "×1" in the backpack to indicate they can be stacked.  
The shop catalog now displays factions participating in the current round.  

Some players have encountered a freeze when clicking the End Turn button. The cause is still under investigation. If you experience this issue, please check for error logs in directories like:  
**C:\Users\username\AppData\LocalLow\GagaRush\BrawlToTheWest\DEBUG**  

Please send any logs found to:  
Email: brawltothewest@163.com

We sincerely appreciate your help! We apologize for any inconvenience caused by this issue.

notes.title: Day1 First Update
notes.content:
Dear players,
The first update is here, focusing on the optimization of the feedback from everyone about "the game is too difficult":

1. Reduce the enemy value of "story mode" normal and challenge difficulty

2. Fix the bug that "reflector" copying "gunpowder barrel" does not work

3. Modify the text description error of "borrowing arrows straw man"

4. Supplement the missing explanation entries of some items

Thank you for playing my game, thank you for your support! If you like it, I hope you can leave a good review for the game, thank you!

notes.title: BIG UPDATE! New cards & New modes & Rank Reset
v0.0.3 patch update announcement 06/03
notes.content:
Last night, due to the increase in the number of registered players, the database memory was full and the player scores could not be modified.
The database has been upgraded to fix the problem.
We are very sorry for affecting the scores of all the players! !

Thank you for playing our game!
